test_cases.label: merge_lists([1,3,6,7], [0,2,8,9]) == (0, 1, 2, 3, 6, 7, 8, 9)
merge_lists with empty lists
test_cases.code:
ll1, ll2 = LinkedList(), LinkedList()
for y in [1, 2, 3]: ll2.insert(y)
assert str(merge_lists(ll1, ll2)) == '(1, 2, 3)'
assert str(merge_lists(LinkedList(), LinkedList())) == '()'

test_cases.label: BST.sum_level on (5, 8, 1, 3, 7, 2, 6, 9)
test_cases.code:
tree = BST((5, 8, 1, 3, 7, 2, 6, 9))
assert [tree.sum_level(lvl) for lvl in (0, 1, 2, 3, 4)] == [5, 9, 19, 8, 0]
